subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Which public WhatsApp sticker-send contract and sticker asset policy should OpenClaw support before implementation?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing action=sticker, an asSticker-style option, automatic WebP detection, and whether to validate or re-encode sticker assets affects user-visible behavior and compatibility for ordinary WebP image sends.

options.title: Use Explicit Sticker Intent
options.body: Expose action=sticker or a WhatsApp send option and route media as stickers only when that intent is present.

options.title: Use WebP Heuristics
options.body: Treat qualifying WebP media as stickers automatically, accepting misclassification and encoding-policy risk for normal WebP images.

options.title: Defer For Cross-Channel Contract
options.body: Keep the low-level helper and inbound sticker handling while waiting for a broader sticker contract across message channels.

recommendation.title: Use Explicit Sticker Intent
recommendation.body: Expose action=sticker or a WhatsApp send option and route media as stickers only when that intent is present.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr has the strongest recent history on the structured WhatsApp send helper and QA driver path that already emit sticker payloads.
